dict.string: Programs running in a Tessera terminal, such as an agent's voice input, can use the microphone when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can use the camera when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can control other apps, for example with osascript, when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can read and write files in your Desktop folder when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can read and write files in your Documents folder when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can read and write files in your Downloads folder when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can read and write files on external drives when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can read and write files on network drives when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal can use Bluetooth when you ask them to.
Programs running in a Tessera terminal, such as a dev server or an agent, can reach devices on your local network.
